name: PEC standard bidding documents and PPRA procurement rules
name_ur: پی ای سی کے معیاری بولی دستاویزات اور پی پی آر اے کے خریداری قواعد
standard: Public Procurement Rules 2004 (PPRA); Pakistan Engineering Council Standard Bidding Documents for Procurement of Works
review_status: unconfirmed. Reference only. Pending review by a Pakistani procurement specialist.
scope_note: Applies to works let by public bodies. A contractor working only for private owners is outside it. The figures are the defaults of the standard form, which a procuring entity may change in the Appendix to Bid, not limits the Rules set.
description: Interim payment certificates are paid within 28 days. Retention is 10 percent of each certificate up to 5 percent of the Contract Price. The mobilization advance is up to 15 percent against a guarantee. The performance security is 10 percent. Delay damages are capped at 10 percent. Prices are adjusted monthly by the Clause 70 formula where Appendix-C is filled in.
planned_not_built_note: The figures are carried in the contract defaults and the public works limits, every one flagged for expert review; no engine rule enforces them. The Public Procurement Rules 2004 were not read.
